findings.issue: Self-entry excluded from the forward existence check, so a broken self-entry passes silently
findings.evidence: gate-self-test.js:204-245 iterates siblingEntries (self-slug filtered out) when checking registry-entry-without-fixture; a self-entry whose fixture_root is absent is never flagged. Reproduced: broken self-entry + one valid sibling returns pass/exit 0.
